package.name: rp1_hardware_interface
package.description: ros2_control SystemInterface for rp1's steering actuators. Talks uavcan.equipment.actuator.{ArrayCommand,Status} directly over SocketCAN using a vendored copy of the same libcanard codec the VESC firmware uses, bridging the gap between ros2_control position commands and the DroneCAN transport (see docs/can_id_map.md).
